tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe established gradient dependence, but five of seven rows still share one gradient. Acquire the trajectory batch to constrain the joint input–gradient response before committing to a law for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It approximates the pilot curve but cannot explain why the low-gradient row has higher flux than the higher-input, high-gradient row.

considered_alternatives.option: Separable gradient attenuation versus gradient-dependent saturation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Both can fit the seven paid rows well below tolerance. Each off-pilot gradient was measured at a different input, so the fits do not establish whether the gradient changes only the flux scale or also the saturation curve.
The auxiliary reading does not distinguish these transfer mechanisms.
